payload.summary_zh: GEO PRO 基于 GEOFlow 2.3.0 的品牌化 fork：深度去上游标识、移除线索表单、新增真后端网站 GEO 体检钩子，并配套 JetSocio 四产品引流 Hub。
payload.summary_en: GEO PRO is a rebranded fork of GEOFlow 2.3.0: upstream branding stripped, lead forms removed, a real-backend website GEO audit added, and integrated with the JetSocio four-product hub.
payload.upgrade_tip_zh: 本 fork 默认关闭上游遥测与更新检查。升级请参考部署文档与 docs/CHANGELOG.md。
payload.upgrade_tip_en: This fork disables upstream telemetry and update checks by default. See the deployment docs and docs/CHANGELOG.md when upgrading.
